The x-axis, labeled “Steps,” represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 450, with tick labels spaced every 50 units. The y-axis, labeled “Training Rewards,” shows a range from approximately -0.1 to 0.4, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.1. A purple line represents the “Llama-On-Policy-Easy” agent, which begins at approximately 0.03 at step 0 and rises to approximately 0.30 at step 450. A brown line represents the “Llama-LUFFY-Easy” agent, starting at approximately 0.01 at step 0 and reaching a maximum value of approximately 0.28 at step 450. Finally, a blue line represents the “Llama-On-Policy-Hard” agent, beginning at approximately 0.02 at step 0 and reaching a maximum value of approximately 0.12 at step 450, while a red line represents the “Llama-LUFFY-Hard” agent, beginning at approximately 0.01 at step 0 and reaching a maximum value of approximately 0.08 at step 450.
